extras: Privacy-first design with no telemetry; works on mobile via pure ICS over HTTPS.
intentEvidence: The existing Outlook Meeting Notes plugin requires Outlook and Obsidian to be open simultaneously, and you drag calendar events between them.
motivation: To allow users to keep their calendar and meeting notes in the same place without exporting data or relying on external servers.
problem: Existing solutions often require external applications to be open or involve manual dragging of events, creating a slow and fragile workflow.

relations.evidence: You ran meetings out of Notion, but you always wanted your calendar and your notes in the same place
If Templater is installed and enabled, your <% %> tokens run after Meetings Plus substitutes its own {{variables}}

summary: Subscribes to external ICS calendar feeds and automatically generates structured, pre-filled meeting notes within the local Markdown vault.
